summary.name: You.com
summary.one_liner: You.com is an AI search and inference platform offering an OpenAI-compatible API for open-weight models plus real-time web search for AI applications.
use_cases: Adding live web search to an LLM application
Running open-weight models through one API
Grounding AI agent answers in fresh web results
Routing requests across providers with failover
Enterprise AI workloads needing data retention controls
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a single OpenAI-compatible API for running open-weight models such as Kimi, DeepSeek and GLM, with requests routed across providers. It offers a Web Search API that connects models to real-time web data, with a Python SDK example that returns titles, URLs and snippets. It lists production controls including zero data retention, US-hosted models, per-model cost visibility, and usage and spend controls. Enterprise options include custom pricing, custom QPS limits, dedicated support, DPA readiness and CCPA compliance.
notable: Multi-provider failover that reroutes requests when a provider is unavailable, with a 99.9% uptime SLA
Built-in web search for models, sold as a separate Search API with a Python SDK
Zero data retention, SOC 2 certified, and US-hosted models
Enterprise tier with custom pricing and rate limits
caveats: Enterprise features such as custom pricing, higher rate limits and custom QPS are available on request rather than listed publicly
Some enterprise security options (ZDR, DPA) are described as available or ready, not as default for all plans
